Sofia, I haven't sent or drafted anything to Corinne yet. Two approvals are needed first:

- **Ruth Calloway** has to approve any mail addressed outside pemberline.com, including drafts. I've recorded that request against this thread, and this message is my reply in it.

The 10% matches the correction Bettina posted in this channel on 2025-11-17, which replaced an earlier 12% note. Once both approvals are in, I'll draft the confirmation to Corinne and send it.
